references.text: The place the Lord will choose to put his name—the central theme of worship at the place God chooses
The place the Lord your God will choose to put his name—the same expression referring to the chosen holy place
The Passover lamb must be slaughtered in the evening—the original Passover ordinance with the same timing
Moses instructs the Israelites to slaughter the Passover lamb—the first Passover celebration in Egypt
Reference to the exodus from Egypt as the background for the festival
Passover is to be celebrated at the appointed time, in the evening—the same timing for the Passover slaughter
The Passover feast on the fourteenth day of the first month
Solomon builds the temple at the place the Lord had chosen—fulfillment of the promise regarding the chosen place
Josiah celebrated Passover for the Lord in Jerusalem—the Passover slaughter at the chosen place
Jesus is called God's Lamb who takes away the sin of the world—a typological fulfillment of the Passover lamb
Christ, our Passover lamb, has been sacrificed—New Testament fulfillment of the Passover sacrifice
